text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer! I... was able to become 
a beautiful flower♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, won't you stand next to me? I want to 
savor this happiness together. Because 
this is... *our* victory!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Thank you for raising me with 
so much care... And thank you... for 
meeting me!
